component.name: PriceRunner Panel
component.summary: Track prices on PriceRunner and get notified when they drop

description.p: Search pricerunner.se, pin the products you want, and the panel checks their prices on a schedule and notifies you when one drops. It tells real deals from inflated discounts and lives in the tray.
Independent hobby project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to PriceRunner or Klarna.
